episodes.title: His Son Was Brainwashed. Then He Confronted the Cult Leaders (Rare 70s Footage)
episodes.description: A heated and thought-provoking debate unfolds as Ted Patrick and Hridayananda Das Goswami confront one of the most controversial questions surrounding new religious movements: does the Hare Krishna movement represent genuine spiritual devotion or a form of mind control? As both speakers passionately defend their positions, the discussion explores issues of religious freedom, personal autonomy, conversion, and the nature of spiritual commitment. In this video, we examine the key arguments, pivotal exchanges, and why this debate continues to spark discussion about religion, individual liberty, and the boundaries of belief. 🧠🔥📖
